caption: The drawing features a single black top hat situated centrally against a plain, light beige background. The hat is rendered in shades of black and gray, showing detailed shading and highlights that suggest a smooth, shiny surface. It has a tall, cylindrical crown with a slight outward flare towards the top, and a wide, curved brim. A black hatband wraps around the base of the crown, tied in a simple bow on the right side of the hat. There are no other objects or decorative elements in the composition.
title: Quaker Man's Hat
